items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: The interviewee discusses Louie's career, recordings, and comparison to other musicians (Freddie, Kepard, Sutler) but does not mention any personal interaction, collaboration, or direct relationship with Louie.

ctx.x: He recorded with Doc Cook too on his Marlick band. But he didn't do a lot of recording. You told me he did record with some of your small groups all the time. Yeah, small groups. You told him on that pile. Yeah.

Freddie could take just a little mediocre group and take that trumpet away where he could improvise and he could do things. I think that Louie was more of a stylist but he could do things. Freddie was. He seemed to have more tricks in store. More improvising. And more improvising.
